'''Blood Pact''' is a [[Dark Pact]] card.  It first appeared in [[The Lurker at the Threshold]] expansion.

==Card info==
When you gain a Blood Pact, restore your [[Stamina]] to full.

'''Any Phase''': While this card is refreshed, any time you would gain any amount of Stamina, you may instead gain that amount of [[Power token|Power]].

You may spend a Power token as either a [[Clue token]] or as 1 [[Sanity]] when you suffer a Sanity loss.

'''[[Upkeep]]''': [[Exhaust]] Blood Pact and lose X Stamina to gain X Power.
